set.acceptance: A testscript with fixture journals and change sets: a failed run and a gave-up run each on a landed change set whose journal never reached its land step, a withdrawn, a rejected and a superseded change set, and one of each on an accepted change set, lists exactly the accepted-change-set items in text and --json; a run on a change set the log does not know stays listed; a question and a sign-off on a landed change set stay listed
set.statement: rhiza inbox leaves out a failed run or a run the daemon gave up on whose change set has landed, been withdrawn, rejected or superseded, so every item it lists names a next command that can succeed on its change set, except a non-plan run on a landed change set whose journal reached its land step, which the daemon resumes and so is listed as failed or gave-up (inbox-omits-resumable-landed-run); questions and sign-offs stay listed
